notes.title: Legal Notice

notes.text: Exposed IOCTL with Insufficient Access Control in the ASUS AURA SYNC driver allows a local user to bypass the driver's verification and invoke arbitrary IOCTLs, resulting in privilege escalation.
notes.title: Risk Evaluation

notes.text: ASUS recommends that users check whether a newer version of their installed ASUS software (e.g., Aura Sync, AI Suite 3) is available, and update to the latest version to ensure the affected legacy drivers are no longer in use.

cwe.name: Exposed IOCTL with Insufficient Access Control

notes.text: Exposed IOCTL with Insufficient Access Control in the ASUS AURA SYNC driver allows a local user to bypass the driver's verification and invoke arbitrary IOCTLs, resulting in privilege escalation. Refer to the 'End-of-Life Notice and Driver Update for Legacy ASUS Drivers ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.
